en: Abbess Dingyi: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join the Hengshan Sect.
Abbess Dingyi: Would you like to join us?
Palace Guard: May I ask what brings you here?
I am the senior disciple of the Huashan Sect. I was sent to deliver Yue Fei's Sword to His Majesty for the war against the Jin. Please make sure he receives it. I'll take my leave.
I am a disciple of the Beggars' Sect. I was sent to deliver this map of the north to His Majesty for the war against the Jin. Please make sure he receives it. I'll take my leave.
It's nice to come into the city now and then.
Gambling's banned across the land now, and every gambling house in the city has closed. But I hear there's still one underground casino open. I'd love to try my luck there.
It's harvest day today, so we've got extra grain to share with those in need.
Exercise often and keep regular hours, and illness will keep its distance.
The Capital is so big! One wrong turn and I'd be lost for sure.
The Capital's guards do their duty well. We all feel safe here.
The Forbidden City is so grand. A fitting home for the Emperor!
I hear the physicians at Tongren Hall are very skilled.
Beggar: Understood. I'll warn all our brothers in the Capital at once. Here is my reply - please take it to the Elder.

Ah Fang: My parents have arranged my marriage, but we're so poor we can't even scrape together a proper dowry. Still, I must have at least one decent piece of jewelry. Could you look for something cheap for me?
Help
Won't help
I hear Mr. Ping Yizhi lives in Xixia now, hard at work on a miraculous antidote.
Oh! These earrings are beautiful! But I can't let you pay for them yourself. Please take these 30 taels.
Are you Su Zhong? Your mother is very worried about you.
I don't want to worry her either, but I've made up my mind to join the army.
Why?
A true man should be ready to die for his country. Our country is in grave danger - how can I just sit and read my books?
Dissuade
Agree
But you're still young. Study hard now, and later you can do far more to help your country rise again!
I suppose you have a point.
Good. Now hurry home to your mother. She's worried about you.
All right. Thank you for the advice, good sir. Please take these 15 taels.
Well said! Young as you are, you have real spirit.
I want to enlist, but I'm worried about my mother. She'll never let me go.
Don't worry. I'll go and talk her round for you.
Buy ticket
Take coach

Xixia

Dali
Yangzhou
Stay here
Please buy a ticket first.
You're carrying too much cargo. It won't fit in the coach.
Buy
Sell
Fine goods of every kind. Have a look!
Hmm, it's all here, nothing missing. Thank you for your trouble, hero. Here are your 500 taels.
Buying a dowry for a young lady, are you? I'm running low on stock, but I'll let you have this pair of pure gold earrings cheap. Just 20 taels.
Taoist Wang lies wounded by the door.
Master Taoist, what happened to you?
Wang Chuyi: Quick! I've been secretly poisoned. Only an antidote made by a great physician in Xixia can draw it out.
Taoist Wang, here is the antidote you needed.
Wang Chuyi: Thank you. Sadly, Yang Tiexin and his wife have both taken their own lives. I'll tell you the details another time. I must go.
Wang Chuyi: Alas! It seems I won't make it to Guiyun Manor in Dali this time.
Will you be staying the night, sir? We have fine rooms at a fair price. Just 10 taels.
Rent a room
Talk
Sorry, sir, we're full. Please try another inn.
All's quiet in the martial world lately. No news to speak of.
I heard someone saw an old man like an immortal flying around Mt. Hua with two disciples. I don't believe a word of it.
Could they be the ones Master is looking for? I must hurry back and tell Master!
Welcome to Tongren Hall, Capital head branch. We offer the finest medicines.
Mu Yi: This is a contest for my daughter's hand. Any hero who can beat her may take her as his wife.
Wanyan Kang: Allow me to show my humble skills. Heh heh.
After a fierce bout, Wanyan Kang defeats Mu Nianci.
Mu Yi: You are truly skilled, sir. May I ask your honored name?
Wanyan Kang: Heh heh, you needn't know my name. I was only having a little fun. Farewell.
Wait! Is that how a real man behaves?
Wanyan Kang: What? You dare insult the young prince of Jin? You must be tired of living!
Wang Chuyi: Enough. Peace is worth more than anything. I ask you both to stop here.
Wanyan Kang: Hmph! We'll meet again!

As the saying goes, "Outside, train sinew, bone and skin; inside, train the breath." Others say, "Outside, train sinew, bone and flesh; inside, train will, essence, qi and spirit." Either way, a martial artist must train both body and mind.
Young one, you have good aptitude. I'll teach you some Basic Swordplay. Would you like to learn?
Teach me
No thanks
My apprentice hurt himself training. First go and find me a Ginseng Pill. When you're back, I'll teach you.
Without a good teacher, you're a blind man groping for the door: twice the work for half the gain, and you may never glimpse the true heights of the martial arts.
What I need is one Ginseng Pill. Come back with it and I'll teach you.
You've mastered everything I taught you. I have nothing more to teach.
Instructor: Oh? Huzi wants to learn martial arts? The boy's a rascal, but he looks to have talent. All right, go tell his dad I'll take Huzi as my pupil. We're neighbors, so there's no fee.
Fine armor for sale.

This is the Capital branch of Fuwei Escorts. We're swamped lately, and a shipment must go to the general store in Dali urgently. You look capable, hero. Deliver it for us and the 500-tael fee is yours.
Deliver
Decline
Good! The shopkeeper there will pay you on delivery. Take care!
Have a safe journey!

Blacksmith: Asking about Huzi's slingshot? I haven't started it. I still need the material, and I can't leave the shop... Tell you what: find me one Ox Skin, and I'll make it right away.
Found one already! Hand over the Ox Skin and I'll get to work. When it's done, take the slingshot to Huzi for me. And tell him not to be such a rascal.

Casino Boss: What are you scared of? The officials will never find out.

Huzi's Dad: That instructor looks like a real master. Our Huzi has loved martial arts since he was little. If only he could study under him! But we're plain folk, and lessons may cost a lot. Could you go and ask him for me?
I'll ask him
Can't help
What, he said yes? Oh, that's wonderful! Thank you so much. Please take these 15 taels.
Huzi: Mr. Blacksmith promised to make me a slingshot. I wonder if it's ready yet. Could you go and ask him for me?
Hooray, hooray! I'm going to play with Tiantian later. I found this weapon outside the city. It's no use to me, so you can have it.
Auntie Su: Oh, that disobedient son of mine! What am I going to do?
Auntie, what's the matter?
Sigh... He was doing so well at the village school, but lately he keeps going on about joining the army to fight. What is he thinking?
Auntie, I think young Su Zhong has real spirit, and he's old enough to answer for himself. Why not let him go?
Sigh... When sons grow up, you can't keep them. Very well, let him go. Here are 20 taels. Please take them.
